_comment: DEPARTMENT REGISTRY. AutoPost is ONE department today (the Social Media Department).
This file exists so more departments can be added later WITHOUT touching the engine.
If this file is deleted or corrupted, scripts/dept_registry.py falls back to a built-in
default that is identical to today's behaviour - so it can never take the system offline.
To add a department: copy the social-media block, give it its own AGENT_SPEC.json and
its own block in rules.json, then set 'active' to its key. Nothing in
department_queue.py or department.py has to change - both read their chain from a spec.

social-media.name: Social Media Department
social-media.tagline: writes one piece of content, has 18 specialists approve it, and will not publish anything it did not check
social-media.note: The first department. 18 chain agents + 3 sidecars. Future departments follow the same shape: their own spec, their own rules block, their own destinations.
